Bondtech INDX · Design 2

Wave cam: one motor

…
11 passive tools in the space of 8 on a CORE One. Each gap has a toggle link at the back: folded it holds 20.5 mm, straight it is a solid 34.5 mm strut. One stepper drives a short cam car along its own linear rail; the car lifts the two toggles either side of the selected holder, and a spring keeps the row against T0. Plungers ride diagonal slots and come forward as their gap opens. Use Upgrade to watch 8 fixed-pitch tools become 11 and the mechanism arrive. Slow the speed to follow the cam.
